name: Tauria
description_en:
Tauria Video Conference has ceased operations. Its official closure notice states that the service was permanently discontinued effective June 1, 2026 and users can no longer create, join or manage meetings.

This record is retained for identity and research history. The previous directory feature labels do not describe an available service, and no current plan or migration arrangement was verified. Do not use this candidate as evidence that a Tauria meeting can be started.
description_zh:
Tauria Video Conference 已停止运营。官方停运说明写明，服务于 2026 年 6 月 1 日永久停止，用户无法再创建、加入或管理会议。

本档案保留产品身份及研究历史。原第三方功能标签不代表服务仍可使用，未核实当前套餐或迁移安排，不能据本候选推定可以发起 Tauria 会议。
